description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'CompanyStructureDaoTest' for testing the 'CompanyStructureDao' class within the OrangeHRM system. It includes setup methods, multiple test cases for CRUD operations on 'Subunit' entities, and uses external utility classes like 'TestDataService'.

classes.name: CompanyStructureDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing various functionalities of the 'CompanyStructureDao' related to Subunit entities within the OrangeHRM admin plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of 'CompanyStructureDao', and populates test data from fixtures.

methods.name: testSetOrganizationName
methods.description: Tests setting the organization name via 'setOrganizationName' method of the DAO.

methods.name: testGetSubunitById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a Subunit entity by ID, asserting it is of correct type and has expected attributes.

methods.name: testSaveSubunit
methods.description: Tests saving a new Subunit entity and verifies it has been assigned an ID.

methods.name: testDeleteSubunit
methods.description: Tests deletion of a Subunit and verifies the tree structure is updated accordingly, as well as confirming deletion.

methods.name: testAddSubunit
methods.description: Tests adding a new Subunit under a parent and verifies the hierarchical structure has been updated correctly.

methods.name: testGetSubunitTreeObject
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the Subunit tree structure and verifies the presence of key attributes.
